The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d94e973e689e60b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: There exist αc ∈ (0, ∞) and ε0 ∈ (0, 1) with the following properties for every fixed ε ∈ [0, ε0) and coordinate law νε. (i) The SAT probability tends to one at every fixed α < αc and to zero at every fixed α > αc. (ii) All the ordered limits in (1.5)–(1.6) exist for their indicated positive arguments. They are independent of ε. (iii) FJ is the cumulative distribution function on (0, ∞) of a probability law of mean one. It has no atom at zero. There are exponents γ, θ such that GJ (u) = u1−γ+o(1) , FJ (s) = s1+θ+o(1) , as the corresponding argument decreases to zero, and γ = 1 2 + θ , 0.4126930 < γ < 0.4126934, 0.4231063 < θ < 0.4231088.
